blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace press officer Claire Castro on Wednesday confirmed the attendance of US President Donald Trump at the 49th Asean Summit in November in Manila. “It is confirmed,” she said at a briefing. Details about Trump’s visit, however, have yet to be disclosed. /gsg
